subject: Humorous GamerTags
author: ZombieTron
body: I like SomeAzHoles tag its funny, and I would never report that. There are quite a few names which fly close to the line but are still clever, funny or not overtly insulting. Its only the real vulgar names which I am offended by the ones which tell me to lick things or want to lick things which shouldn't be mentioned in polite company. Mostly tho I just don't like the ones which are too obvious! if you are going to be offensive at least be clever about it!!
